messages:
tara: FYI invoice-preview shows per-route totals for ACCT-221 drifting vs ledger by ~200 tokens for 04/02 window. Looks correlated with new route_alias header rollout.
sam: I think the proxy started emitting route_alias for canary clusters on 04/02 00:45. Did we map alias -> canonical_route in ingest?
eli: Not yet. Ingest currently keys billing by route_tag header exactly as submitted. route_alias breaks aggregation when the same tenant flips between old and alias values.
nina: Quick mitigation: we could canonicalize on ingest with a small alias map service (map alias->primary) for 24h. But that's stateful. Alternatively add a routing_normalization step in post-agg that stitches route_alias to canonical route before invoicing.
tara: Post-agg stitch sounds safer for now (no hotpath state). But it won't stop per-window double-count if events land in different windows.
sam: True. For window collisions we need to add a reconciliation pass that runs after watermark to merge lines where request_id duplicates span windows. That requires request_id propagated reliably.
eli: Do we have request_id coverage? Edge emits x-req-id but some older clients send x-client-id only. We'll need to fallback heuristics (ip+ts+useragent) but that's noisy.
nina: Suggest short-term: emit an "alias_flag" on ingest events and include alias->route candidates in invoice-preview UI so PMs can see potential merges. Also add an internal attr `maybe_duplicate_req` when request_id absent and heuristics match.
oncall-bot: Incident created: #INC-3552 - route-alias-invoice-drift. Assigned to @sam.
sam: I'll prototype a post-agg stitch job that: 1) groups by (tenant, canonical_route) using alias map 2) looks for request_id overlaps across adjacent windows and moves tokens into the earlier window if within 2min. Pseudocode: ```-- stitch pseudocode INSERT INTO invoices_fixed SELECT tenant, route, SUM(tokens) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(alias_map(route_alias), route_alias) as route, * FROM events WHERE ts >= watermark-2m) GROUP BY tenant, route;```
tara: UX ask: invoice-preview should show a diff column "stitch_suspected" with links to raw events to justify adjustments. Customers get anxious with sudden line moves.
eli: Metrics: add meter `stitch.adjustments` + `ingest.alias_rate` + `preview.stitch_suspects` so we can alert when stitch-adjustments > 0.5% of total tokens for a tenant.
nina: Also plan: require proxy to set x-req-id consistently on retries and preserve route_tag across retries. Will open a PR in proxy repo.
sam: I'll run a canary of post-agg stitch against shadow invoices for two days, compare against current ledger and surface mismatches. Need test tenants: ACCT-221-shadow, ACCT-221-staging.
oncall-bot: Pager rule updated: preview.stitch_suspects > 0.5% -> pager to eng-platform.
tara: Thanks all. Filing follow-ups: sam -> INC-3552, nina -> PR for proxy. I'll add UX tickets for preview UI flags.
